note: Focus rules whose strongest visible affordance is under 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11) as this check measures it — against the page. Read by check:focus-ring. All 29 findings of the 2026-08-29 sweep were fixed rather than recorded, because an invisible focus ring is a defect and not a preference. An entry here needs a reason a keyboard user can still see where they are.

exceptions.design-system/src/components/actions/Clo: The inverse CloseButton exists only for colored or dark grounds, which its CALLER paints; the check scores the ring against the page because a ground set by an ancestor is its blind spot 3. On the grounds it is for, --color-focus-ring-inverse (#f9f9fc) measures 12.46:1 on inverse-surface, 5.02:1 on primary, 6.15:1 on danger, 6.17:1 on success, 6.70:1 on secondary, 4.53:1 on tertiary/info and 3.52:1 on warning — all at or above 3:1. On the page it would be invisible, which is why the default tone keeps --color-focus-ring.
